RIASSTS2-HIGANBANA_RELIC.description: #Gain an additional [gold]Energy[/gold] on the first turn of combat.
RIASSTS2-HIGANBANA_RELIC.flavor: Known as a Spider Lily, Death Blossom, or the Flower of the Dead.
RIASSTS2-HIGANBANA_RELIC.title: Higanbana
RIASSTS2-TALISMANS_RELIC.description: #Gain a Talisman when you Lose HP from any source.
RIASSTS2-TALISMANS_RELIC.flavor: A gift from Inari. Talismans written with blood; incredibly explosive blood.
RIASSTS2-TALISMANS_RELIC.title: Blood Talismans
MEGACRIT-BUCKET_OF_CHICKEN_RELIC.descrip: #You can now gain *Dexterity at *Rest *Sites (3 times max).
MEGACRIT-BUCKET_OF_CHICKEN_RELIC.flavor: After a long day of kicking ass and being a rude fox, Rias loves to kick back with a big bucket of chicken.
MEGACRIT-BUCKET_OF_CHICKEN_RELIC.title: Bucket Of Chicken
RIASSTS2-PROTECTION_TALISMANS_RELIC.desc: #Whenever you lose HP on your turn, gain !B! *Block.
RIASSTS2-PROTECTION_TALISMANS_RELIC.flav: A gift from Inari. Provides protection to the wielder in times of need.
RIASSTS2-VENOMOUS_TALISMANS_RELIC.flavor: A gift from Inari. Poisons those who intend to cause the wielder harm.
RIASSTS2-VENOMOUS_TALISMANS_RELIC.title: Venomous Talismans
RIASSTS2-ENERGIZED_TALISMANS_RELIC.descr: #When you lose HP, trigger the passive ability of your rightmost Orb.
RIASSTS2-ENERGIZED_TALISMANS_RELIC.flavo: A gift from Inari. Boosting the Defect's power when in danger.
RIASSTS2-ENERGIZED_TALISMANS_RELIC.title: Energized Talisman
RIASSTS2-CURSED_TALISMANS_RELIC.descript: #Whenever *Osty loses HP, apply *Doom to the attacker equal to HP lost.
RIASSTS2-CURSED_TALISMANS_RELIC.flavor: A gift from Inari. Dooms enemies who would dare to harm your cute little guy, Osty.
RIASSTS2-CURSED_TALISMANS_RELIC.title: Cursed Talismans
RIASSTS2-CELESTIAL_TALISMANS_RELIC.flavo: A gift from Inari. Calling the power of the heavens to aid The Regent.
RIASSTS2-CELESTIAL_TALISMANS_RELIC.title: CelestialTalismansRelic
